tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba'i rjes gnang zhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra ga ru ḍa ya/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gcig bsdus khro dbang skur bstan pa/ /gdug pa kun 'dul nam mkha' lding / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ bsgom bzlas bsnyen sgrub sogs byed par 'dod na yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang yi dam 'di nyid kyi sku bris 'bur gang rigs/ zhal gnas khang gi babs bstun shar phyogs su gzigs pa'i drung du/ yi dam gyi gtor ma stod zur gsum dbal can smad zlum po mtheb skyus bskor ba/ dkar gsum sogs kyis sbrus pa dang / de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs bkod pa mdzes par bshams la/ dus tshes bzang ba'i phyi dro nas cha gsum gtor ma sogs kyis bgegs bsal/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol du tho dkar 'dzugs/ nang du rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ dang po'i mgon dang zla bzang 'jam dpal grags/ /pad dkar dus zhabs che chung te lo pa/ /nā ro pham thing sku mched blo gros grags/ /gong ma lnga dang zhang ston brag phug pa/ /blo brtan dpal tshul shar chen ngor chen rje/ /grags rgyal legs 'byung seng ge rnam pa gnyis/ /nam dpal bsod lhun mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang / /mkhyen rab byams pa'i mtshan dang rmor chen rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang / /yi dam mkha' lding dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /de nas mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs nas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du mchod yon zhabs bsil nyer mchod sna lnga rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/

oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+haṃ/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ de nas dril bu gsil la/ dharma ra ṇi tshar gsum brjod/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /gsum mam nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ 'gro ba'i don du yi dam bsgom par bya/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bha wa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi klu brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa'i steng du rang sems khroṃ yig kha dog sna lnga las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje khyung khra zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa sku mdog 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin brla ser/ lto ba dkar/ sku stod dmar/ dbu sngon po khyung zhal can/ rwa dang mchu sder rno ba phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya nor bu nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ tsog pu 'gying zhing bzhugs pa'i mgrin par pad zla'i steng du rigs lnga'i khyung kha dog sna lnga rang dang 'dra ba'i phyag g.yas pa rnams na 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad ral 'dzin pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis sbrul bzung ba nas zhal du gsol ba/ snying khar pad+ma dang zla gdan la dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ kha dog sna lnga'i yig 'bru rnams langs stabs su yod pa gsal bar gyur/ rang dang mgrin pa'i khyung gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /gcig bsdus khro rgyal mkha' lding sku/ /nyon mongs brtan g.yo'i dug rnams kun/ /'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rang rang la bstim/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ phreng ba la grangs bzung ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/

gong ltar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal ba'i ye shes sogs kyis bstod la/ 'dod don gsol btab ni/ bdag la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod/ gtor ma a mṛ ta dang swā bhā was sbyangs/ mchod sbyin gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje khyung khra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la satwaṃ/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gong gi bstod pa'i mjug tu/ rdo rje khyung khra 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mjug tu/ bdag gi nongs mchis mthol lo bshags/ /zhes pas bzod par gsol/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ badz+ra mus gtor mgron gshegs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ye shes khyung khra 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs brjod/ bkra shis ni/ dngos grub mchog stsol bla ma dang / /bar chad kun sel yi dam lha/ /mthu ldan bstan srung tshogs bcas kyis/ /bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces 'di rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /kun dga' mtshan can gnas gsar rje'i/ /gsungs las btus te sa skya pa/ /kun blos ma yi don du bgyis// //sarba mad+ga laṃ// ༈ /na mo gu ru ār+ya tā rā ya/ mi mthun 'chi bdag kun sel zhing / /'chi med tshe stsol yi dam lha/ /'phags ma sgrol ma la btud nas/ /de'i sgrub thabs 'bri bar bya/ /'di'i rjes gnang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ tshe sbyin ma'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang sngon 'gro brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ ston mchog sgrol ma paṇa grub ngag gi dbang / /mya ngan med dpal ba ri gle nag pa/ /sgre pa zla gzhon tshul snying sher byang pa/ /'dul 'dzin 'bri gling dam gling chos tshul zhabs/

/lha lung thog gnas chos dbang byang bzang pa/ /bkras rnam bsod dbang dpal rgyal tshar chen rje/ /mkhyen brtse bslab gsum dbang rab bka' 'gyur ba/ /zhā lu bco brgyad mkhyen rab rmor chen rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe sbyin dpal mor bcas/ /gsol 'debs tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ /bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing sems can don/ /tshe sbyin dpal mo bsgom par gyis/ /lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tāṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas tshe sbyin ma mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags/ /yi rang bskol bskul gsol ba 'debs/ /dge rtsa byang chub chen por bsngo/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ tshogs zhing rang la thim par gyur/ de nas swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig dkar po las 'od 'phros yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mchog sbyin dang ut+pal bsnams pa rgyan dang na bzas spras shing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i tāṃ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ gis bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha tshogs sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur sgrib pa dag 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ ār+ya tā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol gyis bstod la/ bsgom pas mi skyo'i bar du sems bzung / skyo na bzlas pa bya zhing tshe sgrub srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tāṃ/ mdun rgyab tu oṃ hā mtha' bskor du ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ya dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor ba/

rtsibs brgyad tā re tut+tā re tu re swā/ mu 'khyud phyi nang la ā li kā li g.yas bskor g.yon bskor/ rten 'brel snying po/ rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas 'od zer sna lngas bskor ba dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ de dag la bdud rtsi babs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ 'od zer dkar po phyir 'phros 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sbubs stong dkar po rno ngar g.yas 'khor me dpung 'bar bar gyur/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar ser mar sngo ljang khu mthing kha'i tshogs spros phyi rol gur khang drug sbrags grub pas tshe bsod rgyas shing zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ bar mtshams thams cad du ut+pa la'i me tog sngon pos rgyas btab par gyur/ spyi bo'i 'od dpag med tshe dpag med du 'phos pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros bla tshe yar dor dang snod bcud kyi tshe bcud bsdus nas bum par thim pa las bdud rtsi zag pas lus gang 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang de lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ rlung ro bsal zhing bum can bzung / mthar yi ge bcu pa ci mang bzlas la gong ltar mchod bstod byas nas rdor sems kyi yig brgya dang ā li kā li ye dhar rnams lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud 'od du zhu gur khang drug dang 'khor lo la thim/ de rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i tāṃ yig la thim/ de mi dmigs pa'i ngang du thim par gyur/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas dkar chag bzhin shes par bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs kyi bsngo ba/ bdag gi tshe rabs sogs kyis bkra shis brjod la ci bder la gnas par bya/ 'di yang drin chen chos kyi rje/ /kun dga'i mtshan can gnas gsar rje'i/ /gsung gi zegs ma las bsdus pa/ /'khon rigs kun dga' blo gros kyis/
/ma yi don du mgyogs par bgyis/ /shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba'i rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
